title: AgentOS Console Beta And Production UX
objective: Build the next AgentOS UX and operations layer: full-screen TUI shell, deterministic projections, operator workbenches, capability catalog, production evidence center, and local-first fleet/governance previews.
entry_criteria: TUI-oriented Alpha final audit is completed.
AgentCore remains the PlanRun lifecycle authority.
SecurityExecutionEngine remains the only side-effect authority.
AOM install/stage remains inert and activation remains runtime-mediated.

waves.name: Console Beta Contract And Refactor Spine
waves.purpose: Freeze Console Beta ownership and split TUI internals without behavior changes.
exit_criteria: TUI module ownership and shell boundaries are documented.
Existing scripted and interactive commands still work.
ProjectionSnapshot is defined as render input, not authority.

waves.name: Full-Screen Operator Shell
waves.purpose: Add full-screen pane layout, command palette and deterministic layout tests.
exit_criteria: Wide and narrow terminal layouts are stable.
Command palette previews actions before dispatch.
Event feed derives from durable projections.

waves.name: Operations Workbench
waves.purpose: Make approval, recovery and support workflows first-class.
exit_criteria: Approval Center shows exact binding diff, expiry and denial path.
Recovery Workbench shows recovery source, rollback needs and safe next action.
Support Console exports redacted evidence and explains degraded state.

waves.name: Capability Catalog
waves.purpose: Expose AgentOS operational capabilities and AOM artifacts safely.
exit_criteria: Launching a capability creates an intent or preview only.
Catalog and AOM views cannot directly execute or activate.

waves.name: Production Evidence Center
waves.purpose: Make release, update, rollback and promotion evidence operator-facing.
exit_criteria: Release provenance, blockers and signing status are visible.
Local update and rollback drill evidence is explainable.

waves.name: Fleet And Governance Preview
waves.purpose: Prepare local-first fleet, registry and governance UX without GA claims.
exit_criteria: Fleet and governance previews are explicit non-GA previews.
Remote features are optional and fail closed.
Final audit decides Console Beta promotion.
